translator.evidence: Original en-GB (British English) difference catalog: 21 regional overrides drafted over the English source (DEFAULT_STRINGS) for British spelling (colour, centred, neighbourhood, catalogue, maximise, organisation, initialised, serialisable). Every other message resolves through the declared parent. Overrides keep the DEFAULT_STRINGS key order, exact placeholders, plural categories and ICU syntax. No upstream translated text was copied. This is AI-assisted project localization; no human or native-speaker translator claim is made. Bounded 2026-10-21 AI-assisted review verified that the ten foundation messages inherit the current English source without an authored en-GB override. This is inheritance verification, not a translated-language or human/native-speaker review.
